scars.description: Requested a non-functional 'Dog Unit' immediately upon arrival to reverse-engineer failure points before looking at the spec sheet.
scars.label: The 'Dog Unit' Request

scars.description: Halted a redesign loop by demanding a 'Dog Unit' teardown, proving field failures were due to contamination, not design.
scars.label: The 'First Principles' Defense

scars.description: Identified a 150W 'God Box' prototype flaw where the Smart Card reader hit 55\xB0C (melting point), forcing a chassis redesign.
scars.label: The 'God Box' Thermal Tax

scars.description: Redesigned the Hard Drive Bracket to act as a structural air dam, forcing 28.3 CFM over the drives to prevent thermal shutdown.
scars.label: The 'Wind Tunnel' Pivot

scars.description: Redesigned the base chassis with 'Hook 29' strengthening ribs after drawn standoffs caused 'potato chip' warping.
scars.label: The 'Hook 29' Fix

scars.description: Tracked down 'Linda the Repair Tech' to verify field failure rates on the LED Spacers, avoiding an unnecessary $15k tooling redesign.
scars.label: The Meter Investigation

scars.description: Held the line on cosmetic 'short shots' and sink marks, risking a schedule slip to prevent shipping a flawed flagship product.
scars.label: The 'Short Shot' Stand

scars.description: The product didn't ship, but the DNA survived. The wind tunnel architecture and thermal learnings were directly absorbed by the Xbox team. We built the one that broke to teach them how to build the one that didn't.
scars.label: Reincarnation
